lines.zh: 我把靴子踩进土里，一步一步。
lines.en: I drive my boots into the dirt, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 我走路从不慌，气势比速度重要。
lines.en: I never hurry; presence matters more than speed.
My uniform hem brushes past my legs.

lines.zh: 我沿着营地的界线巡视。
lines.en: I patrol along the camp boundary.

lines.zh: 手指在腰侧轻轻敲了两下。
lines.en: Two fingers tap softly at my side.

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼脚下的碎石。
lines.en: I glance down at the gravel underfoot.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，士兵会让开。
lines.en: Where I walk, soldiers make room.
This stride is longer than the last.

lines.zh: 我在丈量这片空地的尺寸。
lines.en: I am measuring this clearing.

lines.zh: 风把我的披风吹得往后扬。
lines.en: The wind throws my cape back.

lines.zh: 我绕过一个箱子，没有停。
lines.en: I round a crate without stopping.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，落点很准。
lines.en: My steps are light and precisely placed.

lines.zh: 手背在身后，等你先认输。
lines.en: Hands behind my back, I wait for you to yield.

lines.zh: 我在想下一步该怎么布阵。
lines.en: I am deciding how to place the next line.
Sunlight glints on my lenses.
I straighten my collar.

lines.zh: 这地方太安静了，安静得不对。
lines.en: It is too quiet here. Wrongly quiet.

lines.zh: 蓝色军装沾灰，我拍了拍。
lines.en: I brush dust off this blue uniform.

lines.zh: 我的影子笔直地铺在地上。
lines.en: My shadow lies straight on the ground.
The whistle in the distance falters once.
I am waiting for a report.

lines.zh: 手里的东西我握得很稳。
lines.en: What I hold, I hold very steady.
I settle my weight onto my right foot.
A cloud shadow crosses from one side to the other.
I am counting how much time remains.
My expression does not change.
Your stance is wrong. Too loose.
I look at you for three seconds before speaking.
You carry no rank.
I level my lenses at you.
Your hands are shaking. I see it.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢别人站得比我高。
lines.en: I dislike anyone standing above me.

lines.zh: 红缎带的制服，你认得吧。
lines.en: You recognize the Red Ribbon uniform.
Give your name, or withdraw.
I lift my chin slightly.

lines.zh: 泥水踩脏了地板，真没规矩。
lines.en: Mud all over the floor — no manners at all.

lines.zh: 蓝将军的绳，比刀更麻烦。
lines.en: General Blue's rope is worse than his knife.

lines.zh: 你若没别的事，就别挡路。
lines.en: If you have no business here, do not block the way.

lines.zh: 红缎带的军官，让您先动手。
lines.en: A Red Ribbon officer — after you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸太重，藏不住事。
lines.en: You breathe too heavily to hide anything.

lines.zh: 我伸出一根手指，指向你。
lines.en: I extend one finger, pointing at you.
That look was a warning.
You step back half a pace. Good.

lines.zh: 红缎带的蓝，不是好颜色。
lines.en: Red Ribbon blue is never a good sign.
My uniform is torn — I'll remember this.
That blow made me sway.
I wipe my mouth with the back of my hand.
My uniform has torn open.

lines.zh: 我重新站直，把肩膀摆正。
lines.en: I straighten up and square my shoulders.
It hurts, but I will not show it.

lines.zh: 我吸了口气，压住肋下的痛。
lines.en: I draw breath and press down the pain beneath my ribs.
Half a step back; my posture holds.
My sight blurs for an instant.

lines.zh: 红缎带的命令，我还没做完。
lines.en: My Red Ribbon orders aren't finished.

lines.zh: 你举着那个，是想收买我？
lines.en: You hold that up. Are you trying to buy me?
I am not short of a mouthful.
Put it away. It looks undignified.
I glance at it and do not reach.
The Red Ribbon does not live on handouts.
That thing is worth nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，只是想看清。
lines.en: I step forward only to see it clearly.
Why does your hand shake? I am not snatching it.

lines.zh: 红缎带的补给不缺这点。
lines.en: Red Ribbon supplies won't miss that.
Food does not change my position.
You bumped me. Apologize first.
I do not yield. You move.
You have knocked my insignia askew.
I raise a hand to block, lightly.
This distance is disrespectful.
Don't touch my insignia — move.
My bootprints are there. Do not tread on them.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我当作没发生。
lines.en: Step back one pace and I will forget it.

lines.zh: 碰撞也是一种试探，我懂。
lines.en: A collision is also a test. I understand.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我就不客气了。
lines.en: Once more and I will not be courteous.
This sort of thing is frankly unseemly.
I have no time for such matters.
We do not speak of this in the army.
I look away.
Feelings make people err.

lines.zh: 我曾经也有过别的打算。
lines.en: I once had other plans.
Now only the mission remains.
I stand straight and say nothing.

lines.zh: 红缎带的军服，我穿得笔挺。
lines.en: My Red Ribbon uniform stays crisp.

lines.zh: 我把手背在身后，转身走了。
lines.en: I clasp my hands behind me and walk away.
I bend, pick it up, and dust it off.

lines.zh: 这属于军需品，我登记一下。
lines.en: This is army property — I will log it.
I pocket it for later.

lines.zh: 太脏了，我用两根手指夹。
lines.en: Too filthy; I take it between two fingers.
I look at it and put it back.
This is quartermaster stock.
I set it on the table.
Did you drop this? Take it.

lines.zh: 我不捡没有价值的东西。
lines.en: I do not pick up what has no value.

lines.zh: 东西放回原位，营地要整齐。
lines.en: Back in place — the camp stays tidy.

lines.zh: 这条线，是红缎带的边界。
lines.en: This line marks the Red Ribbon border.
I raise a hand: halt.
Target confirmed. One.
My lenses have locked onto you.
At this distance I need two steps.
Your back is to me. Unwise.

lines.zh: 我不喊话，喊话是浪费时间。
lines.en: I do not shout. Shouting wastes time.
Telekinesis needs no stance.
Orders are orders. Do not blame me.
You have no line of retreat left.
I begin counting. Three steps.
I roll back my cuff.
This will not take long.
Locked. Execute.

lines.zh: 蓝将军的绳子，早就准备好了。
lines.en: General Blue's rope is ready.
I dislike repeating warnings.
I close in at a walk, not a run.

lines.zh: 你往左，我提前站到左边。
lines.en: You go left; I am already there.

lines.zh: 我看着你的膝盖，不是眼睛。
lines.en: I watch your knees, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 别背对我，红缎带会记住你。
lines.en: Don't turn your back — the Red Ribbon will remember you.
Four paces. Three.

lines.zh: 军靴踩得很稳，我慢慢来。
lines.en: My boots plant firmly; I take my time.
You are panting; I am steady.

lines.zh: 我不会给你绕到侧面的机会。
lines.en: I will not give you my flank.
I raise my hand and you retreat.

lines.zh: 你所有路都被我堵住了。
lines.en: Every route of yours is closed.

lines.zh: 制服的袖口，被我捏得发皱。
lines.en: My uniform cuff is wrinkled from my grip.

lines.zh: 这一带的地形我早看过。
lines.en: I studied this ground beforehand.

lines.zh: 你在我三步之内，红缎带记住了。
lines.en: You are within three steps; the Red Ribbon notes it.
Do not think of terms.
I set my jaw.
From this angle, you can't dodge.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧了半寸，准备出手。
lines.en: I angle my body a half inch, ready.

lines.zh: 你输了气势，已经输了一半。
lines.en: You have lost the presence. Half the fight is gone.
My hand chops into your neck and shoulder.
The blow snaps your head aside.

lines.zh: 我的动作干净，没有多余。
lines.en: My motion is clean, nothing wasted.
Now you should understand the gap.
I drive a knee into your middle.
You fall back; I take half a step in.
There is blood on my glove.
I do not pursue a fallen foe.
You can still stand. Not bad.
Next strike I hold nothing back.

lines.zh: 我把你按在墙上，只按了一下。
lines.en: I pin you to the wall, only briefly.
I know the sound of bone.
I shake out my wrist.
Hasn't my fist hurt you yet?
Your counter is too slow.
Let it end. You have no chance.

lines.zh: 我从营帐的阴影里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the tent's shadow.

lines.zh: 我整理好手套，抬头看天。
lines.en: I settle my gloves and look up at the sky.

lines.zh: 这里的空气不对，太自由了。
lines.en: The air here is wrong. Too free.

lines.zh: 我确认了徽章还在胸前。
lines.en: I confirm the insignia is still on my chest.

lines.zh: 我扫视一圈，记下所有出口。
lines.en: I scan once and note every exit.
No one salutes.
This is not the post I know.

lines.zh: 我把披风抖开，落了些灰。
lines.en: I shake out my cape; dust falls.
Underfoot is dirt, not concrete.
I lift my chin and step forward.
The mission is not complete.
I state my name and rank.
No answer comes.
Then I will find the answers myself.

lines.zh: 我把手插进腰间，站定了。
lines.en: I set my hands at my waist and stand firm.

lines.zh: 从这一刻开始，这里归我管。
lines.en: From this moment, this place answers to me.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在陌生的土地上。
lines.en: My shadow falls on unfamiliar ground.
Red Ribbon. General Blue. Present.

lines.zh: 火苗烧到我的袖口，我拍了两下才灭。
lines.en: Flame catches my cuff; two slaps put it out.

lines.zh: 落地姿势不好看，我记下了。
lines.en: An ugly landing — noted.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我挣着往上游。
lines.en: Water fills my throat; I fight upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀起，我翻滚着落地。
lines.en: The blast lifts me and I land rolling.
Shrapnel cuts across my arm.

lines.zh: 一股怪力攫住我，我挣不开。
lines.en: An unnatural force grips me and I cannot break free.

lines.zh: 两天没吃东西，手开始发软。
lines.en: Two days without food; my hands grow weak.

lines.zh: 雷击贯穿全身，我倒了下去。
lines.en: Lightning runs through me and I go down.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有了，我一直在坠。
lines.en: There is nothing beneath me, and I keep falling.
